key_observations_html:
• Platform competition is increasingly distribution-led: partnership depth and channel reach are becoming stronger share drivers than technical differentiation alone. Related: Uber tests how tokenization can put idle cash to work with HSBC, Franklin Templeton (CoinDesk).
  • Scale tends to reinforce itself: once platforms establish issuer and liquidity depth, they often capture a disproportionate share of incremental distributed value. Related: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time (CoinDesk).
  • Custody and issuance integrations are moving rankings first: Stacks that win issuer workflow and distribution partnerships tend to climb platform rank ahead of category-level RWA totals. Related: Institutional Crypto Custody: A Guide to Roles and Control (The Defiant).
